rationale: Both legs are lifted verbatim from previously tested archive signals (the balance-sheet current-accrual leg from "DebtAdjusted CurrentAccrual Issuer" and the financing-gap leg from "Accrual Financing Gap Strain") and MIN(rank,rank) is near-collinear with MUL(rank,rank), so this is closer to a leg-swap/aggregator tweak than a substantively new mechanism, though the sign logic is internally consistent.

Replacing the failed delta-based maturity leg of "Rollover Accrual Fragility" with a maturity-structure level is an economically motivated (not cosmetic) change and the sign logic is coherent, but dlc/at − dltt/at conflates overall leverage with maturity mix (a zero-debt firm and a balanced-maturity firm both score ~0), so a normalized dlc/(dlc+dltt) would be a cleaner test.

The nested MIN is internally redundant — whenever oancf > 0 (the typical case) MIN(prstkc−sstk, prstkc−sstk−oancf) collapses to the second term — so the expression reduces to essentially MIN(net debt issuance, buyback shortfall) interacted with accruals, i.e., a cosmetic relabeling of the already-tested "DebtFunded Payout CashShortfall."

This is a plain product of two long-established standalone anomalies (Sloan accruals and leverage/liability growth, a close cousin of asset growth) and is effectively the sign-flipped, level-versus-delta twin of the archive's null "AccrualRepair Deleveraging," offering no new economic content.

The MIN is taken over unit-inconsistent quantities — a fractional share-growth rate versus an asset-scaled equity change — so for the typical firm (csho growth ≈ 0, ΔCEQ/AT > 0) the equity term mechanically wins and the "dilution" conditioning silently disappears, meaning the expression does not compute the stated hypothesis; rank-standardize each leg before combining.

This is industry-demeaning applied to the exact two legs of the archive's best performer ("Accrual Financing Gap Strain"), a standard neutralization refinement with no new mechanism, and it actually discards that signal's sign-sensitive structure in favor of a plain rank product whose short leg pools low-accrual/low-financing firms with mismatched cases.
